note:
2026-10-19, NOT LAUNCHED: the trick-2 audit loop of m3-hybrid-t2-loop-2 (the same settings, base shards, seeds and machine), with hybrid training labels (docs/m3-hybrid/audit-loop.md §12): every training label this run makes (the targeted harvests; the three base shards are the stored exact ones, reused) is H_3, exact search through trick 2 and the adopted O_3 (f5766a…) at the start of trick 3, instead of an exact solve to the end of the hand; 10% of those rows are still labelled exactly (hybrid_exact_share 0.1, the exact anchor, drawn by each row's key), and the trick-3 positions picked by label_exact_leaves are solved exactly instead of being valued by O_3. label_exact_leaves "race:1-4" is a PLACEHOLDER: the lead replaces it with the winning exact-leaves rule (from the o3-exactleaf / o3-learnedleaf checks; a learned term names its model by its stored key, learned:inputs/sha256/<hex>:t=T) before launch. The validation shard, every audit shard and the rough test stay exact, so the loop's standard is unchanged. Memory: with exact leaves each label thread also holds a 64 MB leaf-solve table (about 16 GB more at 245 threads; the runner lowers the label tables if needed, never a value). Cost: the targeted harvests' labels drop from seconds to milliseconds of thread time each (plus the exact anchor and the exact leaves); the audit shards are unchanged. Base note of m3-hybrid-t2-loop-2 follows.

Resume of m3-hybrid-t2-loop-1 after the vast balance ran out (2026-10-18 15:30 Irish): the same loop, its three stored base shards reused (label_inputs: random 1.2M, rules 300k, val 50k; nothing relabelled), round 1 retrained (about 2 min, the same seed and data, so the same network 505a0c7c... is expected) and its audit and targeted harvests made again from the same seeds. Rounds 1-4 about 12-15 h on a 245-thread EPYC 7742 at $0.72/h; cap $20 (loop-1 spent $14.72).

Trick-2 audit loop (O_2, cut 2), scratch mode as the overnight trick-3 and trick-4 loops (owner, 2026-10-17): exact labels, a fresh network each round, the capacity ladder from 2048-1024-256, the auditor at gamma 0.001 on 200,000 fresh trick-2 positions a round, targeted harvests of 250,000, at most 4 rounds. No trick-1 golden set (owner, 2026-10-16): flat when a round's audit confirms no weak group; the saved trick-1 worlds are a rough test, reported only. Every label is stored for later runs: the base shards (upload_shards), every audit shard (shared before it is deleted) and every targeted shard. No harvest_net: no O_2 exists yet, and O_3 cannot drive a trick-2 harvest (search labels refuses a network of another trick; the runner now checks it at the start), so round 1's audit shard is made after round 1's training, driven by that network; base labels are random play and rules-v1 self-play only. partial_epochs 2: each round's training starts beside the round before's targeted harvest (hours at trick 2) and waits after 2 epochs for its shard (docs/m3-hybrid/overlap.md). Labels: 1.2M random play (s511), 300,000 rules-v1 (s512), 50,000 validation (s601); per round 200,000 audit + 250,000 targeted (3 targeted harvests in 4 rounds): 3.1M labels in all. Machine (owner, 2026-10-17): the mechanism test's own (AMD EPYC 7742, 245 threads, 264 GB, RTX 4060 Ti 16 GB, $0.72/h) once the test passes, else a cheap one with at least 240 threads, any GPU of 16 GB (the trainer holds about 3 GB of rows). Measured on the first mechanism test (EPYC 7B12, 122 threads): 7.4 thread-seconds a random label, 10.3 a rules-v1 label, about twice the build VM's figures used below, so on 245 threads of that generation the 4 rounds take about 28-33 h ($20-24 at $0.72/h). Cost from the build VM's trick-2 measurements with item A (random 3.65, rules 3.5-4.2, harvested 1.4-3.5 thread-seconds a label) and a rented thread 1.0-1.3 times slower: base labels 5.2-7.0 h on 300 threads, 4.1-5.5 h on 384; an audit shard 0.26-0.83 / 0.20-0.65 h; a targeted harvest 0.32-1.04 / 0.25-0.81 h; about 2 h of setup, round-1 training, the round-1 rough test (its verification sample) and the auditors. All 4 rounds: 9.2-15.5 h on 300 threads ($9-15 at $1.00/h, $13-22 at $1.40/h, $18-31 at $2.00/h), 7.6-12.5 h on 384 ($8-13, $11-18, $15-25); flat after round 1: 6.7-9.0 h on 300 ($7-18), 5.5-7.3 h on 384 ($5-15). Launch with --max-dollars 35 (the owner's trick-2 budget): no corner of the projection reaches it. Memory: labels hold about 200 MB a thread (256 MB tables: at most 98 GB at 384 threads), the trainer about 3 GB of rows and the rough test's verification table 8 GB: about 100 GB in use at 384 threads, so 128 GB is enough (the 384-thread EPYC 9654 offers have 129 GB). Upload floor 100 Mbps: the shards are about 2 GB and a slow uplink timed uploads out on a mechanism test. Disk: about 4 GB of shards.
